elements.description: Saved prompt templates whose variables are filled in place.

properties.name: templates
properties.description: The saved templates, in list order – each with a title, an optional category and a body with {variables}

properties.name: value
properties.description:
Id of the chosen template – unset or unknown shows the first. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change
listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: values
properties.description:
The variables typed so far, per template; a missing one shows its template default. Changed by the user unless
a tc-values-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: onUse
properties.description:
Called with the finished prompt when Use is pressed (only once every variable is filled). A promise keeps Use
pending until it settles; a rejection says so on the tray and Use can be pressed again

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading over the list, and the group's name

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: Another template is chosen ({ value: string }); cancelable

events.name: tc-values-change
events.description: A variable was edited ({ values: PromptValues }, every template's values); cancelable

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: The finished prompt is on the clipboard ({ prompt: string }) – not when the clipboard refused it

props.name: value
props.description: Id of the chosen template (controlled when defined)

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Id chosen at first when uncontrolled – defaults to the first template

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the template's id when another template is chosen

props.name: values
props.description: The variables typed so far, per template (controlled when defined)

props.name: defaultValues
props.description: The variables to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description: Every edit to a variable, with the values of every template

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called once the finished prompt is on the clipboard – not when the clipboard refused it

props.name: title
props.description: The heading over the list, and the group's accessible name – "Prompts" by default
